confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable for a popular surf-tourism town. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because Siargao's accommodation supply and pricing vary widely by location and season, and the July pricing window adds some uncertainty. Beer, cocktail and wine values follow typical Philippine tourist-town price levels. The FX observation came from a search summary citing the RBA's 15 October 2026 figure; I did not read the RBA page directly, so verify it against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Philippine island tourism towns with similar surf and backpacker demand (for example Siquijor, Puerto Princesa and Siargao-area peers), adjusted down from Boracay-level prices for restaurants and accommodation. Western-style café and restaurant prices are set higher than local carinderia prices.
